actions.name: Saint's Legion (Reinforcements)
actions.description:
As a "wild" creature or NPC, Saint's Legion may be used to summon a @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e-digimon-expansion.digimon-species.7ZLJhwLJCUehOojv]{Gargomon}, Piddomon and a Manticoremon to the field 5 levels lower than the user.

As an owned creature, Saint's Legion allows the owner to carry a Gargomon or a Piddomon, and a Manticoremon in addition to their normal Party size, and they may be summoned to the field as reinforcements using Saint's Legion.
